Name: Aaliyah Ne'liya Yerasuun
Other names: Amber, Aaliyah, Aali, Aaliyah Fireheart, Princess Aaliyah, Ne'liya, my Ne'liya, Ne'rahiya Aaliyah, Ne'rahiya na Akunda, Princess of Akunda, Aaliyah nay Yonvaan, Her Highness, Your Highness, Great Flame, Little Flame
How it's said: AAH-lee-yah neh-LEE-yah yeh-rah-SOON
Summary
The Princess of Akunda and only daughter of Lord Yonvaan Yerasuun. Her name means "Great Flame, Little Flame". She's a Valisian mage trained by Sarrah, and she fights with a halberd.
Details
Realm: Mortal world
Race: Human
Gender: Female
Home: the palace, Akunda
Appearance
Aaliyah has curled orange hair resting against deep brown skin.
Personality
Aaliyah is warm, playful and quick to tease.
History
Aaliyah is the daughter of Lord Yonvaan Yerasuun and Lady Zih'ah Saara Yerasuun.
Abilities
A Valisian mage with a talent for fire.
Notes per book
Shards of Light (Book 1).

* Aaliyah meets the crew when they're summoned to the royal docks.
* At the welcoming dinner her father asks Sarrah to take her along.

Remains of Blight (Book 3). Aaliyah leads the story alongside Jim.
Family
Parents: Yonvaan Akumes Yerasuun, Zih'ah Saara Yerasuun
Grandparents: Ramus Yerasuun, L'Lyris Yerasuun
Relationships
Former teacher: Sah'ra Jane Crystalline
Friends: Elsabella Disruptive Rosemary, Ruby Eloise Sterling, Thomas Terrance Smith
Admires: Jim Armstrong
Crew of: The Grey Wanderer
Lives in: Akunda
Spoilers
Her father's possession by Zornov is revealed in Remains of Blight.
